config.description: Preregistered deterministic multi-start reliability extension of the existing anchor-free pure-PWE experiment. Only requested targets and initial geometries vary; no physics, optimizer, or acceptance threshold changes.
config.case_order: target-major Cartesian product, starts in listed order
config.target_selection: Four prescribed gap widths selected before any new physics evaluations, not copied from historical geometry responses.
config.starting_point_selection: Center and two opposite off-boundary starts in the existing normalized parameter box; no saved inverse solutions.
config.acceptance: Search must match the unchanged internal tolerance, and the unchanged candidate must pass both the existing M25 error tolerance and error-plus-cutoff-change guard. Record every attempt, including nonmatches.
config.checkpoint_reuse: Only identical checked evaluations computed within this new experiment; no historical response tables or candidate anchors.
config.scope: Exploratory sampled-path gap recovery from three deterministic starts, not a statistical population estimate, unique inverse, full-Brillouin-zone certificate, or proof of global feasibility.

effective_forward_config.description: Preregistered implementation-only anchor-free mathematical inverse prototype. Do not launch PWE searches until the explicit audit gate is reviewed.
effective_forward_config.geometry: para: fixed-center oppositely oriented disk-clipped equilateral triangles
effective_forward_config.projector: fixed homothetic radial extension, direct Fourier quadrature
final_refinement_checks: Report whether abs(G20-target)+abs(G25-G20) is within the unchanged existing final tolerance.
M25 is an independent check of the same geometry, not a correction fitted to the target or any COMSOL result.
A two-cutoff agreement is an empirical check, not a certified continuum error bound.
effective_forward_config.gradient_reliability_policy: Reliable only after the caller checks simple edge modes, active-k uniqueness or justified equal edge sensitivities, and finite analytic gradients; otherwise bounded coordinate polling.

required: Root reviews radial direct-quadrature analytic versus finite-difference sensitivities.
Root reviews full-path frequency and gap convergence across quadrature orders and Fourier cutoffs.
Root explicitly decides that the new evaluator is suitable for a separate exploratory inverse run within the user-authorized research time.
Old validated solver, old inverse engine, and historical results remain unchanged.

effective_forward_config.scope: Three positive sampled-path-gap requests, one fixed off-grid nominal start; deterministic local minimum-norm steps do not establish uniqueness, global reachability, or full-Brillouin-zone gaps.

measurements.material_agreement_scope: Finite diagnostics only; no newly fitted material tolerance.
